limitations: These four captures pass the approved execution/quality/custody gates only, not full-trace acceptance
One capture per arm per schedule; no significance or statistical speedup claim
Official Nsight instrumentation overhead is present; profiled footer times are excluded from all16 unprofiled trials
Model-process API host interval sums may overlap across threads and with OSRT; they are not additive elapsed time or an exclusive causal decomposition
No NVTX prediction/upload ranges: normalized totals are descriptive, not per-upload or token/TTFT/request latency
OSRT thresholded userspace call intervals do not prove CPU running time, scheduling, physical IO or upload-pending ownership
Ordinary memcpy endpoint NULL stays unobserved; no zero inference
CPU initial memset/packing costs and upload-completion gaps unobserved
Unknown dropped events and exhaustive API coverage remain unproven
A live worker final endpoint has one creation/2559 reuses/zero observed joins; no post-owner-drop join witness is invented
Raw ignored local containers/SQLite/receipts are not published; only compact derived evidence and hashes are versioned

engineering_interpretation.observed: Retained has25116 extra host-pin allocations and25116 host frees per run, while stream-sync calls fall by150696 (six per logical upload). Pin/free host sums increase by about29.5-29.85s despite about4.04s less stream-sync API time. Event create/record/destroy/wait each increase by one per logical upload, and NOT_READY queries increase. H2D bytes/counts and kernel names/counts match
engineering_interpretation.causal_scope: Pin/free churn is a directly observed large host API outlay consistent with the prior whole-test regression; these partial profiled sums do not fully explain or prove exclusive causality for unprofiled elapsed differences
engineering_interpretation.minimal_next_recommendation: Keep default unchanged; prioritize a separately reviewed bounded retained pinned-staging reuse/pool with full lease/charge/consumer-proof lifetime accounting, then same-cut quality plus measured A/B. Grouped-event submission can be tested separately but fewer fences alone is not a speedup claim
